concerns.text: Under-reach: the source idea's methodology explicitly requires an 'Independence Check: Validate findings against an independent dataset (e.g., bulk RNA-seq time courses from different cohorts) to ensure results are not artifacts of a single dataset's noise profile.' No user story, FR, or success criterion in the spec covers independent-dataset validation. Constitution Principle VII also mandates it ('MUST be validated against an independent dataset'). Add an FR/SC anchoring this validation step.
